About Me

I’m Umme Hanee Monon, a Civil Engineering diploma graduate from Ahsanullah Institute of Technical and Vocational Education and Training (AITVET). I’m passionate about civil design, project coordination, and turning ideas into practical, real-world solutions. I have hands-on skills in AutoCAD, Microsoft Office, and MS Project, and I enjoy planning, problem-solving, and working with a team. I’m now looking for an opportunity to grow, gain more practical experience, and build a long-term career in the civil engineering field.
